title: nf/dkfz_rnaseq pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

bam.errorMessage: STAR aligned bam files. If files are sorted use --donot_sort and if files are markdup use --donot_markdup. This has to be coupled with Chimera sam input

sam.errorMessage: STAR chimera sam files, this has to be coupled with STAR aligned bam files

status.errorMessage: Status must be provided and cannot contain spaces

replica.errorMessage: Replica must be provided and cannot contain spaces

library.errorMessage: Identifies the physical tube of prepped RNA/DNA. If you sequence the same physical library across multiple lanes, they share this LB tag. Duplicate marking tools require this to accurately find PCR duplicates. Must be provided and cannot contain spaces

platform_unit.errorMessage: Usually the flowcell barcode and lane. This is strictly used by analysts to track down hardware-specific batch effects or sequencing lane failures. Must be provided and cannot contain spaces

donot_sort.errorMessage: Do not sort if BAM file is already sorted

donot_markdup.errorMessage: Do not markdup if BAM file is already markdup
